prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1405; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not put my name on it yet, if that's alright. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit.
Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was making a left turn at a signaled intersection in Katy, Texas. I had the green arrow, or at least I believed I did.
Q: What happened as you turned?
A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction came through the intersection and struck the front passenger side of my car. I had already started into the turn, so I couldn't avoid it.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Only for a second. It was moving quickly, and I didn't have much time to react.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?
A: Yes to the seatbelt. The airbags did deploy on my side.
Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?
A: Yes. My left knee took most of the impact against the dashboard area. It swelled up fast, and I've had trouble bearing weight on it. I've been told it may need an MRI.
Q: Did anyone else ride in your vehicle?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still dealing with the knee pain and I'm hoping to get my car repaired soon. I'm willing to provide any records I have.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
